findings.claim: The move into INSTRUCTIONS.md silently broadens 'Decide, don't defer' from plan/design review to all clarifying questions.

findings.reason: The Codex and Gemini templates contain only the persona lines plus 'Read the contents of @INSTRUCTIONS.md…', and install.sh only copies INSTRUCTIONS.md beside them with no inlining. Whether each CLI resolves `@file` relative to ~/.codex or ~/.gemini depends on the tool, not on this repo, so the code doesn't settle it.
findings.claim: Codex/Gemini instruction files reach the shared rules only through an `@INSTRUCTIONS.md` reference that those tools may not resolve.
findings.evidence: The whole of ~/.codex/AGENTS.md is the persona block plus "Read the contents of @INSTRUCTIONS.md for shared laws, constraints, workflow, and orchestration." GEMINI.md.template does the same. install.sh only copies INSTRUCTIONS.md next to the file (sync_templates into ~/.<tool>/). Nothing inlines it or tells the agent where the file is. If a tool does not resolve `@INSTRUCTIONS.md` relative to ~/.codex/, that tool runs without the shared rules, which defeats the change's stated goal of installing shared content into every tool.

findings.reason: install_tool runs sync_templates/sync_directory for SRC_SHARED and then src_tool into the same dest_dir with no override awareness, so the ping-pong would happen on a collision. No collision exists in this change: shared has AGENT-PERSONA/USER-PERSONA/INSTRUCTIONS, agents, skills, while the tool dirs have only differently named templates and commands. This is a latent design gap against the 'overrides' header, so I lowered it to low.
findings.claim: If shared and tool-specific items had the same name, every run would overwrite one with the other and warn 'not in source'.
findings.evidence: install_tool runs sync_templates/sync_directory for SRC_SHARED (phases 1–3) and then again for src_tool (phases 4–5), all into the same dest_dir. The header comment (line 16) calls src/user/.claude/ "Claude-specific overrides & extensions".

findings.reason: SKILL.md:36 and :38 send cross-project preferences to `~/.claude/AGENTS.md` and context to `~/.claude/projects/*/memory/MEMORY.md`. install_tool now installs this skill into every tool's skills/, and INSTRUCTIONS.md requires invoking it after any correction. So a Codex or Gemini correction lands in Claude's files, which those tools never load.
findings.claim: The shared self-improving-agent skill tells Codex and Gemini to save corrections into Claude's config, so their own sessions won't keep them.
findings.evidence: install_tool() installs this skill into every selected tool’s skills directory, and INSTRUCTIONS.md.template requires invoking it after user corrections. Its destination table nevertheless specifies ~/.claude/AGENTS.md for cross-project preferences and ~/.claude/projects/*/memory/MEMORY.md for remembered context.
